Attach from Inbox in a draft

From Drafts in the main Mail window, use Right preview or Bottom preview and choose Resume draft. In the editor, choose Attach from Inbox and check the draft’s exact To, Cc and Bcc. Choose files by their source sender, subject and date, then select Add selected files. The picker shows files stored on this device, including completed Inbox downloads still in the five-minute transfer cache. If a file has expired, preview it in the reader and reopen the picker. You can preview the added PDF, remove the old version and choose Save draft. Cancel or Escape keeps your edits. The 25 MiB outgoing attachment limit applies.
